title: Static deployment and optional services
description: Publish dist/ to Cloudflare, Vercel, Netlify, EdgeOne, ESA, or your own VPS, and register optional external services in config.yml.

cells.title: Publish one dist/ folder to cloud platforms or your own VPS.
cells.text: Run npm run build to generate dist/. Because EdgePress has zero runtime dependencies, cloud platforms skip heavy installs and deploy static files directly.

cells.heading: Cloud hosting configuration
paragraphs: Each static host reads its own config file: wrangler.jsonc for Cloudflare, vercel.json for Vercel, netlify.toml for Netlify, edgeone.json for Tencent EdgeOne Pages, and esa.jsonc for Alibaba Cloud ESA Pages.
Log in with your chosen platform CLI before running a local deploy command. GitHub Actions checks security and compatibility rather than deploying production sites.

cells.title: Deploy to a platform or VPS
cells.code:
npm run deploy:cloudflare
npm run deploy:vercel
npm run deploy:netlify
npm run deploy:edgeone -- -n my-site
npm run deploy:esa -- --name my-site
edgepress d --dry-run
edgepress d
edgepress d --target prod-eu

cells.heading: Deploy to one or more VPS nodes with edgepress d
paragraphs: In a private, uncommitted config.yml, configure deploy.vps (or deploy.vpsTargets for multiple nodes) with host, username, remotePath, and one auth option (password, passwordEnv, or privateKey). Install the optional ssh2 package when uploading directly over SFTP.
Add hostKeySha256 if you want EdgePress to verify the SSH server fingerprint before uploading. Run edgepress d --dry-run first to inspect the generated files without connecting.

When you deploy to multiple targets, EdgePress uploads them concurrently and stages files before swapping them into remotePath. Your VPS only needs SSH/SFTP and a static web server such as Nginx or OpenResty. See agent.md for the full checklist.

cells.heading: Optional external APIs and widgets
paragraphs: Register third-party tools in config.yml under plugins.consent.services. Use external-api with backendUrl for user-triggered requests, or external-widget with backendUrl and moduleUrl for an isolated UI.
Fill in a unique ID, name, purpose, dataCategories, recipient, retention, and HTTPS privacyUrl for every enabled locale. Never place API secrets in client config.
Browsers load registered modules only after the visitor grants consent. If you change a service URL, visitors must review and approve it again.

cells.title: Call a registered API from theme JS

cells.heading: Cache headers
paragraphs: EdgePress adds content hashes to CSS and JavaScript filenames so Cloudflare, Vercel, Netlify, and EdgeOne can cache them for one year. HTML and unversioned JSON stay short-lived so rebuilds take effect immediately.
On Alibaba Cloud ESA Pages, configure one-year caching for hashed CSS and JS in the dashboard while keeping HTML revalidated.
